meta.title: bothouse
meta.description: DSH models and local Claude Code or Codex in one group. The first row, "bothouse", is the background service the others need; leave it on. Channels, team desk, bothouse panel and other computers switch on separately.

relay.summary: Not on the same network? Use a relay
relay.privacyNotice: A relay is a server operated by you or someone else. It cannot read your content, but it can see your IP address and traffic volume.
relay.admissionPlaceholder: Leave blank for open relays; enter the operator's code for private relays
relay.hostTitle: Let another computer connect via relay
relay.hostHint: Once connected to the relay, generate a one-time connection string (valid for 5 minutes) and paste or scan it on the other computer.
relay.controllerHint: Paste the string generated on the other computer, verify the relay address and fingerprint, then confirm.
